description: Check a TRON address before sending USDT: whether Tether froze it (read from the USDT contract), fraud and risk flags from TRONSCAN, whether it is activated, TRX/USDT balances, age and activity, token approvals, and what a USDT transfer to it would cost. A clean result does not guarantee the recipient is safe. Use it when the user gives a specific T… address; for network-wide freeze statistics use get_usdt_freezes. Returns one JSON object with a source page. Live on-chain read, cached for 60 seconds; limited to 10 checks per minute per IP. Errors on an invalid address.

address.description: TRON address to check, in base58 (starts with T, 34 characters), e.g. TNiq9AXBp9EjUqhDhrwrfvAA8U3GUQZH81. Hex (41…) and EVM 0x addresses are rejected.

name: check_address
title: Check a TRON address
